headline: The build blinks first
fortune: Before Thursday’s chai cools, a build you expected to babysit turns green on its first run. Do not make eye contact; it may notice.

headline: The flaky test apologizes
fortune: That test haunting your week passes three times before lunch. Screenshot it quickly; this is rare wildlife.

headline: The demo behaves suspiciously well
fortune: Your next screen share loads instantly, the button works, and nobody says “you’re on mute.” Take the historic win.

headline: Lunch solves the ticket
fortune: While explaining the bug before lunch, you hear yourself say the missing answer. Mithu will invoice you for consulting.

headline: The useful message arrives
fortune: At 3:14, a teammate replies with the exact clue you need—and only one emoji. Productivity has peaked.

headline: You finally name the thing
fortune: The perfect variable name arrives in the shower tomorrow. Keep a towel near the keyboard, not the keyboard near the shower.

headline: The fix is outside your chair
fortune: Five minutes into tomorrow’s tea break, the clean solution strolls into your head like it pays rent there.

headline: A meeting disappears
fortune: One afternoon meeting gets cancelled twelve minutes early. Protect that tiny holiday with your whole calendar.

headline: Closing tabs opens a portal
fortune: You close nine forgotten tabs and immediately find the document you needed. The remaining 38 demand legal representation.

headline: Five lines get fan mail
fortune: Your smallest pull request gets three approvals before stand-up. The diff is tiny; the victory lap is full size.

headline: Deleting code wins the day
fortune: By Friday you remove more code than you add, and everyone calls it elegant. Please bow responsibly.

headline: One tiny detail gets noticed
fortune: The little interaction you nearly skipped makes someone grin during review. Acceptance criteria are briefly jealous.

headline: The wrong branch forgives you
fortune: A scary-looking mistake is completely recovered in under ten minutes. Ctrl+Z accepts another lifetime-achievement award.

headline: The draft saves your dignity
fortune: You catch one wildly premature message before sending it. Future-you sends flowers; present-you simply closes the tab.

headline: The rollback lands softly
fortune: Next week, plan B works so smoothly that plan A pretends this was the roadmap all along.
